meta.chedTypeDescription: Pre-notification for import of products of animal origin, germinal products and animal by-products (POAO)
meta.boundaryRule: A Title is CHED-P iff (case-insensitively) it contains the token 'ched-p' or 'chedp' AND does NOT contain 'ched-pp' or 'chedpp'. Because 'ched-p' is a string-prefix of 'ched-pp', a naive substring match over-selects the 65 CHED-PP (plants) traces; those are excluded by the double-p filter. Directory notification/ched-p/ is treated as distinct from notification/ched-pp/.
notes: No accessibility/ched-p-* traces exist in this corpus (0 found).

Only 4 of the 96 CHED-P traces carry errors (all errors=1): three ched-p-cloning runs (46581cbd, 69034597, a8789bde) and one ched-p-auto-clearance run (8ac2e05d). These are the highest-value traces for real error/validation copy in this subset; the broader 38-error figure in the corpus is dominated by other CHED types.

Fish flag: db2d277c (CHED-P Fish Notification) is genuinely CHED-P (fishery products are POAO) but sits on the IUU-catch-certificate boundary — flag for the Comb wave to decide whether the fish/IUU-specific surface is in scope.

relevance sort order applied: core-journey, then validation, then variant, then post-submission (no peripheral in the CHED-P subset — every selected trace is explicitly CHED-P-parameterised, none merely incidental).
